I accept Data collection disclosure %s uses the Android VPN service to provide you with uncensored access to Internet content. We collect, aggregate, and store the following information: Your city, country, ISP, and optionally, approximate location. The city, country, and ISP are derived from the IP address that you connect to our servers from, and the IP address itself is never logged. This data is collected for usage and performance statistics and service health purposes.> Your email, when you send us a diagnostics or crash log feedback. Make sure that AzadiTunnel is open and connected and the NFC Bump icon is showing in the app bar on the other device. With the NFC Bump dialog open on your device and the app open and connected on the other device, place your devices back to back to initiate a connection information data transfer. Once the connection information data transfer is complete and your app is able to connect, the NFC Bump dialog will close automatically. Responsible use Use AzadiTunnel responsibly and only in ways that comply with applicable laws and the terms of services you use. No guarantee AzadiTunnel cannot guarantee uninterrupted access, complete anonymity, or protection against every type of network monitoring.
